They have a graduation ceremony at the city hall this July.

Part 2. Choose the item among A, B, C or D that best answers the question about passage.
Which of the following was NOT mentioned in the article?
A. The number of people killed each year by these storms.
B. The tremendous power of hurricanes when they hit land.
C. The damage caused by hurricanes and tornadoes.
D. The time of year when they are most likely to strike.
cac_cau.ghi_chu: Phương án B in "The tremendous power killed each year by these storms." (vô nghĩa; bài đọc không nói sức mạnh bị giết mỗi năm, nên đọc theo chữ thì B cũng là điều không được nhắc tới). Sửa thành "The tremendous power of hurricanes when they hit land." (bài đọc có nói) để chỉ còn A đúng.

ghep.hoi:
Part 2. Choose the item among A, B, C or D that best answers the question about passage.
Which of the following was NOT mentioned in the article?
cac: The number of people killed each year by these storms.
The tremendous power of hurricanes when they hit land.
The damage caused by hurricanes and tornadoes.
The time of year when they are most likely to strike.

cac_cau.de:

Stilt houses play an important role in the culture of many ethnic groups in Viet Nam. In many ethnic villages, family activities such as eating, entertaining, and worshipping happen in the stilt house.
a. For example, Tay and Nung people have their stilt houses overlooking the fields.
b. The most important room in all stilt houses is the kitchen.
c. However, the styles of stilt houses of different ethnic groups are not the same.
d. They avoid letting the houses face mountains, rivers and forests.
e. The kitchen is in the centre of the house, with an open fire, and is a meeting place for the family.
On the contrary, a Thai stilt house should face mountains and forests because they believe that this view increases vitality. Meanwhile, the Rong house, a communal stilt house of Bahnar people, is located in the centre of their village.
A. b – a – e – d – c
B. a – c – d – b – e
C. b – e – c – a – d
D. c – d – b – e – a
cac_cau.ghi_chu: Đáp án in C là "b – e – a – c – d": câu a (For example, Tay and Nung ...) đứng ngay sau hai câu tả gian bếp thì không có gì để làm ví dụ, còn câu d (They avoid ...) phải nói về người Tày, Nùng thì câu kết "On the contrary, a Thai stilt house should face mountains" mới đối lại được. Không phương án in nào đúng. Sửa phương án C thành "b – e – c – a – d" (gian bếp; However: nhà sàn mỗi dân tộc một kiểu; For example: nhà người Tày, Nùng), giữ đáp án C. Sửa ngữ pháp "letting the houses facing" thành "face"; "Bhanar" thành Bahnar như SGK Unit 4.
